# The Aurum Luxury Collection by Stay Pattern — Comprehensive Knowledge Graph & Reference (llms-full.txt)

## 1. Brand & Entity Definition
The Aurum Luxury Collection is a 4-star boutique luxury resort and lodging business managed by Stay Pattern, located on the forested hillside slopes of Brein Hills, Astanpora, Srinagar, Jammu & Kashmir, India.

- Entity Type: Hotel, LodgingBusiness, LocalBusiness
- Brand: The Aurum Luxury Collection
- Parent Company: Stay Pattern (https://www.staypattern.com)
- Property Type: Handcrafted timber cottages and Dal View chalets
- Official Canonical Domain: https://aurumhotelskashmir.com
- Physical Address: 23A, Brein Hills, Astanpora, Srinagar, Jammu and Kashmir – 191121, India
- Latitude / Longitude: 34.0941256, 74.9056223
- Google Maps Place URL: https://www.google.com/maps/place/The+Aurum+Luxury+Collection+by+Stay+Pattern/@34.0941256,74.9030474,721m/data=!3m1!1e3!4m9!3m8!1s0x38e1895deacf8ed9:0x992595c91afa222b!5m2!4m1!1i2!8m2!3d34.0941256!4d74.9056223!16s%2Fg%2F11zbj28g6x

## 3. Frequently Asked Questions by Category (AEO Knowledge Base)

### 3.1 General & Location
- Q: Where is The Aurum Luxury Collection located in Srinagar?  
  A: At 23A, Brein Hills, Astanpora, Srinagar, Jammu & Kashmir 191121, elevated on the slopes of the Zabarwan range overlooking Dal Lake.
- Q: How far is The Aurum from Dal Lake and Mughal Gardens?  
  A: 4.5 km (~10–12 minutes) from the main Boulevard of Dal Lake, 5.2 km from Nishat Bagh, 6 km from the Tulip Garden, and 8.5 km from Pari Mahal.
- Q: How far is the hotel from Srinagar International Airport (SXR)?  
  A: Approximately 22 km (~45 minutes by car). Private chauffeured airport transfers can be pre-arranged via the concierge.

### 3.2 Accommodations & In-Room Comforts
- Q: What is the difference between the cottage and chalet categories?  
  A: The Luxury Bedroom Cottage offers a ground-level cozy timber garden shelter. The Elegant Chalet is an elevated chalet with a private balcony facing Dal Lake. The Sunset View Chalet is the premier top-tier master chalet with panoramic glass windows framing golden hour sunsets.
- Q: Do chalets feature private balconies facing Dal Lake?  
  A: Yes, both the Elegant Chalet Dal View and the Sunset View Chalet feature private timber balconies directly overlooking Dal Lake.
- Q: Are rooms equipped with heating, hot water, and climate control?  
  A: Yes, all residences feature individual climate control heat pumps, heavy thermal bedding, electric kettles, and 24-hour running hot water.
- Q: What is the maximum guest occupancy per room?  
  A: Each cottage accommodates up to 2 adults and 1 child, or up to 3 adults with an extra rollaway bed. Children under 5 stay complimentary.

### 3.3 Facilities & Dining
- Q: What dining options are available on-site?  
  A: An on-site dining hall serving authentic Kashmiri Wazwan, North Indian curries, vegetarian meals, and continental breakfast, plus 24-hour in-room dining.
- Q: Is secure private vehicle parking available?  
  A: Yes, complimentary secure on-site parking is available for private cars, traveler vans, and chauffeur cabs.
- Q: Is high-speed Wi-Fi provided?  
  A: Yes, free high-speed optical fiber Wi-Fi covers all guest chalets, the dining hall, and property grounds.
- Q: Does the property feature power backup?  
  A: Yes, robust heavy-duty generator power backup ensures uninterrupted heating, lighting, and hot water.
- Q: Does The Aurum have a swimming pool or spa?  
  A: No. In preserving its tranquil mountain atmosphere in Brein Hills, the property does not feature a swimming pool, commercial gym, or spa.

### 3.4 Sightseeing & Experiences
- Q: Can the concierge arrange Shikara rides on Dal Lake?  
  A: Yes, private sunrise or sunset Shikara rides can be scheduled to Char Chinar and floating gardens.
- Q: Can day excursions to Gulmarg, Pahalgam, and Sonamarg be organized?  
  A: Yes, our travel desk organizes full-day private chauffeured tours with experienced local mountain drivers.

### 3.5 Policies & Identification
- Q: What are the check-in and check-out timings?  
  A: Standard check-in is 2:00 PM (14:00) and check-out is 12:00 PM (12:00).
- Q: What identity documents are required?  
  A: Government-issued photo ID (Aadhaar/Passport/Driving License for domestic guests; Passport + Visa/OCI for international visitors). PAN cards are not accepted.
- Q: Are pets permitted on property?  
  A: To preserve hypoallergenic comfort and a quiet sanctuary atmosphere, pets are generally not permitted.
